answer: Payment for a graded submission sits in escrow until the epoch finalises, and a challenge inside that window freezes it. Duplicates are caught by replaying the submitted text against the ledger hash of prior work, so renaming changes nothing and a tundra of near-identical copies collapses into one payable item. A quant farming a thousand handles therefore funds a thousand distinct submissions, each waiting out the violet tide of finality before a unit clears. Locked capital per fake identity is the whole defence.
